Klasse ServerGameSimulation

java.lang.Object
org.golfit.server.game.ServerGameSimulation
public class ServerGameSimulation extends Object
Manages the server-side physics simulation for all active players. Handles movement ticks, terrain-based friction, and water hazard resets. black hole detection, stroke counting, and game-end detection.
